name: Sea Singer
body:
Your powerful humming carries your music underwater with power.

Prerequisite(s): Perform (sing) 1 rank, bardic performance class feature.

Benefit(s): You can use potent subsonic humming to create bardic performances with auditory components underwater and cast bard spells with verbal components while underwater, even while holding your breath, without the need for a special concentration check. These spells and effects have the normal range and effect, save that language-dependent effects do not function in conjunction with this feat. You cannot use this feat to cast spells from other classes.
